patches.field: terms[4](人工知能学会倫理指針).detail_zh
patches.before: 最后一条规定，如果 AI 本身成为社会的一员或与之相当的存在，它也必须能像会员一样遵守本准则。
patches.after: 最后一条规定，AI 本身要成为社会的一员或与之相当的存在，就必须能像会员一样遵守本准则。

patches.field: terms[4](人工知能学会倫理指針).detail_en
patches.before: The final article states that if AI itself becomes a member of society or something close to one, it must be able to follow these guidelines just as members do.
patches.after: The final article states that for AI itself to become a member of society or something close to one, it must be able to follow these guidelines just as members do.

patches.before: 政府・企業・研究者・利用者など立場を問わず、社会の側が守るべき事柄としてまとめられている。
patches.after: 社会 (特に国などの立法・行政機関) の側が留意すべき事柄としてまとめられている。
patches.reason: Rule A L2 一次資料の対象

patches.before: 归纳的是不论政府、企业、研究人员还是使用者，社会一方都应遵守的事项。
patches.after: 归纳的是社会（特别是国家等立法、行政机关）一方应注意的事项。

patches.before: framed as what society should observe regardless of role, whether government, business, researchers or users.
patches.after: framed as what society, especially legislative and administrative bodies such as the state, should keep in mind.

patches.before: so that people can develop together with AI.
patches.after: so as to build an environment in which people can develop together with AI.
